validation_summary.logical_role: Finite corroboration, not the basis for a general theorem or independent-review status.

claims.argument: record_sort validates every original DAG node before normalization. The stored types bit at j-1 is an inductive invariant. The mapping stack sends each old child to its earlier normalized root. Each macro has its explicitly stated classical definition; NUM follows the exact binary Horner recurrence. The final duplicate for NUM(1) preserves the designated root. Thus normalization is well typed and denotes precisely the stipulated definitional expansion, not arithmetic or general logical equivalence.

For valid normalized inputs, pa_same traverses pairs of corresponding nodes, checks their tags and binder/variable labels, and recursively checks every child. Child indices strictly decrease along each branch. Therefore acceptance is equality of expanded syntax trees, ignoring sharing and unreachable records, with exact binder indices. No alpha-equivalence or merely equal numeral values are silently accepted.

pa_free stops below a quantifier binding the queried variable. pa_free_for rejects exactly a path where a binder for a free replacement variable encloses a free occurrence to replace; matching substitution-variable binders stop traversal. pa_sub_equal stores its blocked state separately for each pending branch, and compares the replacement tree at every free matching variable. Together these checks implement the standard free-for substitution condition, including shadowing. This reasoning concerns all finite trees, not the finite test sample.

The three fixed wildcard patterns are the classical implicational K/S and contraposition axioms. Wildcards admit only formulas and repeated occurrences must match the same expanded tree. Universal elimination checks its explicit term and free-for condition. Quantifier distribution checks its shared binder and absence of that binder free in the antecedent. Equality reflexivity and Leibniz replacement are valid under the two explicit free-for checks. These standard classical Hilbert schemas with MP and generalization form first-order logic with equality; the Leibniz schema contains the usual function and relation congruence instances.

Independent decoding of all seven literal Q pattern codes yields exactly the documented closed Q axioms with indices0 and1. Rule8 recognizes precisely the normal form of (A(0) and forall i(A->A(Si)))->forall i A, with the identical A and binder in every required position. All arithmetic formulas and parameters are permitted. The open schema and its usual universal parameter closures derive one another by universal elimination and generalization. The extra Q predecessor axiom is derivable in ordinary PA by induction on the disjunction x=0 or exists y x=Sy, so retaining it is a conservative presentation choice.

check_pa_proof validates exact header, positive length, six cells per row and zero reserved fields. It normalizes and sort-checks every line and the target. MP references are strictly earlier; lookup in the reverse list uses index-reference-1 and verifies both antecedent and consequent trees. Generalization checks its earlier formula and the exact binder; no external assumptions exist in this format. All other rows pass the explicit axiom checks, and all unused auxiliaries must be zero. Exact end-of-stream and final-target equality are mandatory. Induction on rows proves acceptance iff the submitted sequence is a proof in the named calculus.

Every decoding loop consumes a strictly smaller positive code, every counted traversal has a finite count, and every pending-tree branch descends through earlier DAG nodes. A normalized N-node DAG expands into at most an exponential number of tree occurrences; all counters, coded stacks and output lengths consequently have primitive-recursive bounds in the original numeric inputs. Arithmetic, sequence and finite-tree invariants are provable in PA by natural-number induction. Thus this is a primitive-recursive finite checker on all natural inputs, with malformed inputs totalized to0, not a resource-bounded proof relation.

The separately independently reviewed acyclic-call compiler and register allocation preserve this inspected integer source. The independently reviewed instruction/finite-beta-trace compiler represents exactly its halting executions. Substituting output=NUM(1) therefore gives Proof_PA(p,x), for all finite proofs, while an API budget only limits an individual executable run. The raw graph is PA-equivalent to the separately checked existential bounded-matrix presentation; raw prenex syntactic Sigma1 status is not asserted.
